subSpace.description: This Elevated space is an extension of the Main Hall and has its own entrance. The attendees sitting in this space can see the Main Hall and stage. The space does not come with any content.

venues.byRequest:
• Buffet tables with wipeable tablecloths
  • Backdrop + Panel Covers
  • Windows Covers
  • Tables + Linens
  • Other type of chairs
  • Dinnerware + Utensils
  • MC Podium
  • Projector + 150" projector screen
  • Smart TV
  • Whiteboard
  • Video/Audio Conference for video calls
venues.description: All you need to host your corporate meetings, conferences, dinners, special events, wedding, etc. The Main Hall is about 1500 sqft (with a possibility to extend up to 1900 sqft with the Elevated Area) features a stage with a beautiful tree mural, 90 fabric chairs, a sound system, projector, and a kitchenette. It also has natural light and high cathedral ceilings, perfect for large events.
venues.maxCapacity:
Max Capacity based on Main Hall only (without the optional extension space):
  • Rectangular Tables - 76 people
  • Circular Tables - 70 people
  • Theater Style - 110 people
  • Cocktail / Reception - 120 people
  • Conference Room - 36 people (or 60 people with double rows)
  • Classroom Style - 50 people
venues.equippedWith:
• Beautiful High Cathedral Ceiling
  • 90 Fabric Chairs
  • Stage with a Beautiful Mural on Stage Wall
  • Speakers and wired Microphone (with stand)
  • Wi-Fi Internet (high speed)
  • Assisted Elevator Access (to stage and part of hall)
  • Natural Light, Dimmable Lights and Disco Lights
  • A/C, Heating and 2 adjustable ceiling fans

advancedPricing.cancellationPolicy: Full refund will be given for cancellation requested up to 20 business days prior to the start date. The deposit is non-refundable if cancellation occurs less than 20 business days before the event. All fees are non-refundable if cancellation occurs 5 business days or less before the event.

fields.label: Sound and Bass Control Policy

options.label: Please confirm your agreement to these terms.

fields.fieldDescription:
The Organizer is responsible for ensuring that sound and bass levels after 11:00 PM do not cause disturbance to neighbouring properties. CollabÃ¼ro will provide a decibel meter for reference and recommends that sound levels do not exceed 90 dB, with all exterior doors and windows kept closed. This guideline is for reference only; the Organizer must take all necessary precautions to avoid disturbing neighbours, including ensuring that attendees outside the buildingâwhether near the main doors, in the parking area, or on the patioâremain relatively quiet.

Please note that bass levels are not measured by the provided decibel meter. The Organizer remains fully responsible for managing bass levels after 11:00 PM. If a DJ, band, or AV company is hired, it is the Organizerâs responsibility to inform them of these requirements and ensure compliance.

If a by-law officer or police issues a ticket related to noise disturbance, the Organizer will be solely responsible for accepting the ticket and paying any associated fines. Failure to comply with these rules will result in the fine amount being deducted from the security deposit, and all future booking requests at our venue will be declined.

fields.label: Set up Services

options.label: Budget-friendly DIY Set-up Service
options.infoText: Full room layout with placement of furniture as per agreed plan including linens and chair covers (if rented through Collaburo).

options.label: Concierge Set-up Service (Banquet)
options.infoText: Same as the DIY Option, with full dinner service layout on tables (dishes, glasses, cutlery, napkins, centerpieces, chafing dishes, utensils) as well as buffet set up (adding hot water to chafing dishes and wrapping cutlery if needed). All items need to be provided by 7pm the evening before the event to a Collaburo staff (unless rented through Collaburo). Note:  One hour of this service will be part of the booking period (ex. if booking start time is at 4pm, then signing up with this Concierge Set-up service will start at 4pm)

options.label: Concierge Set-up Service (Reception/Cocktail Buffet)
options.infoText: Same as the 1st option (DIY Option), with the set up of the buffet table only (adding hot water to chafing dishes and wrapping cutlery if needed). All items need to be provided by 7pm the evening before the event to a CollabÃ¼ro staff (unless rented through CollabÃ¼ro).

fields.fieldDescription: Collaburo has 3 types of set-up services to choose from

options.label: Server
options.infoText: Designated Collaburo staff (with black pants/shirt and Collaburo apron) will be the server for your event. These staff will help in all aspects of the event: Serve food at a buffet; Plate food with table service; Clear plates between courses; Cut cake, plate and serve; set-up and clear-up chafing dishes and buffet; Clear up small messes/spills during event; clear tables, buffet and handle recycling as per our Walk away service. Generally 1 waiter is required for every 25 attendees. EXCEPTIONS: No alcohol related tasks. No selling services either.

options.label: Coordinator Services during event
options.infoText: Client can request for one of our experienced Event Managers to be on site for a period or entire time of their event. They will ensure the smooth running of the event on the day itself; essentially, they take charge of every detail to make the event successful.

options.label: IT Services
options.infoText: Basic IT services such as connecting to the Wi-Fi, projector, and sound system are included in your rental and can be handled at the start of the event. For additional IT services such as manning the PTZ camera or controlling microphones, additional fees apply.

options.label: Event Planner
options.infoText: Time spent helping the organizer plan last-minute details in the weeks leading up to the big event. Creating a timeline for the day, coordinating with 3rd party vendors for delivery, set-up and pick-up.

options.label: Security Services
options.infoText: Security Guards experienced in events are required for Public events (where guests are unknown to the client or the event is advertised on social media) but optional for private events. Guards will be on site for the period between guests arrival and departure unless requested to be on site at the beginning of the booking period.

fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Please fill in any details about the required work.

fields.label: Clean-up Services

options.label: Budget-friendly DIY Clean-up Service
options.infoText: Client is expected to take home all their belongings (including any 3rd party items that the client rented without CollabÃ¼ro's help or have 3rd party items picked up at end of event - the client is responsible for coordinating with the 3rd party), recycle into the appropriate garbage/recycle/compost/cans bins. If 3rd party rentals were done by CollabÃ¼ro, it is expected that client wipe off food debris from the dishes (into Green Bin), empty liquids from glasses into sink, wipe out and empty the water from chafing dishes, and place everything back into the transport containers they came in. Any rented linens needs to be put into the provided laundry bag. Any extra cleaning time caused by not doing the above will incur extra cleaning fee. The use of confetti or anything that takes longer to clean may also get charged an extra fee dependent on the extra time incurred.

options.label: Walk-Away Service (Banquet)
options.infoText: Client can choose to select the Walk-Away Service, and leave the space as if they were leaving a restaurant. Client is still expected to take home all their belongings (including any 3rd party items not rented through CollabÃ¼ro). 1 hour of this service is included in the booking period (ex. if booking end time is 8pm, then signing up with this Walk-Away Service will start at 7pm, and final course of dining must be done at 7pm).

options.label: Walk-Away Service (Reception/Cocktail Buffet)
options.infoText: Fee is for up 2 hours and $25 / additional hour - Client can choose to select the Walk-Away Service from a reception/cocktail space without doing any cleaning. Client is still expected to take home all their belongings (including any 3rd party items not rented through CollabÃ¼ro). Based on our experience, 2 hours is usually enough time for a full clear up of the space.
